recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13137 unless the work group chooses to make a new, broader editorial change to the messaging page.
issue_request: FHIR-13137 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core messaging change request for STU3 asking to remove the statement that asynchronous messaging is less reliable than synchronous messaging and to avoid the term "reliable," with suggested wording about asynchronous messaging being harder to implement because of complexity.
initial_application: Git commit 412cfd0450d7daa8a9865244f7785808a7a578b7, matching the Jira comment's SVN revision 12854, changed source/messaging.html from "asynchronous messaging is less reliable than synchronous messaging" to complexity wording.
additional_context: source/messaging.html is the active Messaging page, with source/hierarchy.xml listing messaging.html in the specification hierarchy and multiple active pages linking to it. Current source line 180 says asynchronous messaging can be harder to implement due to complexity compared to synchronous messaging. Later commit c8fa06a62c66956aeacf0394eca3d614906c52f0 polished "opposed to" into "compared to" without reintroducing the reliability assertion. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the Jira decision and no source edit is needed.
